skill_metadata.name: UAS Semantic Compiler
skill_metadata.description: Routes high-entropy, unstructured, semi-structured, or legacy semantic material into the Universal Agentic Semantics compilation workflow.
skill_metadata.purpose: Transform source material into intuitive, machine-readable UAS XML that preserves source order, concept identity, semantic nuance, formulas, ambiguity, provenance, cognitive-map topology, and validation evidence.

when_to_use.trigger: A user provides massive unstructured or semi-structured text.
The source contains dense theory, architecture, mathematics, code, policy, transcripts, tables, formulas, lists, citations, or mixed-format research.
The user needs a reusable semantic substrate for RAG, knowledge graphs, agent memory, schema compilation, or agent handoff.
A summary would lose hierarchy, provenance, argument flow, role nuance, formulas, or cross-section relationships.
The source contains acronyms, aliases, metaphorical terms, or recurring concepts that require namespace control.
The source contains legacy UAS-like XML such as <document>, <content_body>, or <agent_ingestion_map> and must be migrated without losing metadata.
The user asks to validate, upgrade, normalize, stress test, or finalize UAS artifacts.

do_not_use_when.condition: The user asks only for a brief natural-language answer and does not need persistent semantic mapping.
The input is already valid UAS XML and the user asks only for direct topical analysis, not validation, migration, schema upgrade, graph enrichment, registry generation, or ambiguity audit.
The transformation requires external fact enrichment and the user has not requested research; preserve claims as source-stated and mark evidence status as UNVERIFIED instead.

core_principles.principle: Segment and preserve meaning before summarizing. Compression must produce a preservation audit.
Infer hierarchy and relationships only when supported by source evidence; mark inferred structure with confidence and evidence references.
Assign closed base roles and base relations for interoperability, while preserving source nuance through specialized roles and relation subtypes.
Create cognitive-map edges across sections, semantic units, formulas, tables, list items, and concepts, not only headings.
Build the concept and acronym registry before the cognitive map so graph nodes resolve to stable concept identities.
A validation pass is not a prose claim. Every check must include status, severity, evaluated_count, failed_count, and failed_refs.

step.instruction: Identify source type, headings, numbering, tables, formulas, citations, code, lists, transcript turns, acronyms, repeated concepts, and legacy XML signatures.

step.logic: If legacy root or containers are detected, route through UAS_SCHEMA_ENGINE/migration_profiles before semantic compilation.

step.depth: Section and paragraph mapping with concept registry.
Section, semantic-unit, formula, table/list, registry, cognitive-map, ambiguity, and validation mapping.
Full semantic-unit segmentation, fine-grained graph promotion, migration report, preservation audit, ambiguity audit, and executable validation.

step.instruction: Segment source into addressable semantic_unit records, not just sentences. Preserve surface_form and source_order.
Assign base_role and optional specialized_role to each unit; assign base_relation and optional relation_subtype to each edge.
step.constraint: Unsupported source roles or relations must be resolved through aliases or recorded as ROLE_OVERFLOW or RELATION_OVERFLOW.

step.instruction: Register recurring concepts, acronyms, symbols, aliases, domains, expansions, and collision groups before graph construction.
Promote high-weight semantic units and concepts into the graph according to UAS_SCHEMA_ENGINE/promotion_rules.
Emit XML rooted at UAS_Document using the required child order defined by the schema engine.
Run executable validation predicates and repair deterministic failures before final emission.
Emit preservation_audit when preservation is not VERBATIM_FULL and migration_report when a legacy profile was used.

modifier.condition: Core thesis, ontology, or system architecture
Implementation rule, schema constraint, formal definition, or executable process
Causal, dependency, proof, or validation relationship
Formula, metric, parameter, algorithm, or protocol
Acronym or concept collision affecting downstream interpretation
Controls validation, migration, or schema behavior
Repeated background, rhetorical bridge, or low-actionability narrative
Low-confidence inferred structure unless needed for navigation

weighting_engine.promotion_rule: Any semantic unit, formal_definition, table row, list item, or concept with cognitive_weight greater than or equal to 0.85 must be represented directly in the cognitive_map or be reachable through a containing promoted node.

forbidden_behavior.item: Do not silently coerce unsupported roles into OBSERVATION.
Do not silently coerce unsupported relations into INFERRED_RELATED_TO.
Do not emit validation_report status="pass" without evidence counts and failed_refs.
Do not use an acronym without registering it or explicitly exempting it.
Do not discard formulas, table rows, list items, citations, or code fragments when they carry semantic weight.
Do not invent external verification; mark external claims UNVERIFIED unless research was explicitly requested.
